Direct LTL and TL Service
We pioneered the Direct Delivery industry. Our load in sequence techniques have been copied but never equaled by our competitors. With over 25 years experience, our Direct Delivery System will insure that your cargo is enabled with a reduced handing concept that results in faster transit times, reduced claims and improved freight presentation. We deliver tiered levels of service to match your service needs.
Request a Freight Quote Today
Need pricing for your shipment? Provide a few details, and a JTS Express rep will contact you with a custom quote.
Request Rate
JTS Express delivers dependable LTL and truckload transportation with a personalized approach. We operate privately and provide every customer with a single point of contact. We also offer tailored logistics solutions, including warehousing, distribution, and specialized services that support a wide range of industries.
